id: title:Gilbert09:promote google analytics source to ga

review.posthog_relevance: Google Analytics warehouse ingestion connector promotion from BETA to GA, removing the gating feature flag.
review.reason: The change promotes the Google Analytics warehouse source configuration from BETA to GA, removing the release status and its associated feature flag. P1.F1.H1 demonstrates the removal of the BETA status and the feature flag, while P1.F2.H1 updates tests to reflect this change. This establishes a substantive, bounded capability improvement: the ingestion connector becomes a standard
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit relies on the connector's stability and compatibility, which are not demonstrated by the removal of the flag alone. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are both supplied and complete. No uncertainty exists between them; they share the same path and represent a single coherent change group. No abstention is required.

observations.behavior: The Google Analytics warehouse source configuration is promoted from BETA to GA, and its feature flag is removed.
observations.posthog_connection: This change removes the gating feature flag and BETA status, allowing the Google Analytics warehouse ingestion connector to become a standard, released capability available to all users without requiring a specific feature flag. This could improve reliability and supportability for warehouse ingestion workflows.

observations.behavior: Tests are updated to reflect the removal of the feature flag and the status change to GA.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk does not change implementation, but it does update the test expectations to match the new configuration. This is a necessary change to maintain test compatibility after the configuration change. It does not independently establish benefit, but it supports the correctness of the configuration change.
